notes.title: Roommate has a 50% discount!
notes.content:
[b]Roommate will be at 50% of its initial price for one week.
This is your chance to buy it if you haven't already. Or buy it for a friend![/b]

This game contains two chapters.

In the first one,
You will play as Alvin who is in love with Naomi - his lovely roommate - but unfortunately in a relationship with a moron.
You will help her break up or stay with him, but it will have consequences.
For a duration of about an hour, this chapter is short but very cute.

In the second one, you play as one of your 3 favorite characters from the game and conquer the heart of your loved one(s?).
